+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_low_level_operations_after_disconnect() -> None:
+    messages: list[Message] = [
+        {"type": "websocket.connect"},
+        {"type": "websocket.disconnect", "code": 1000},
+    ]
+
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        return messages.pop(0)
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    websocket = WebSocket({"type": "websocket", "path": "/"}, receive=receive, send=send)
+    await websocket.receive()
+    await websocket.receive()
+
+    with pytest.raises(
+        WebSocketDisconnected,
+        match='Cannot call "receive" once a disconnect message has been received.',
+    ):
+        await websocket.receive()
+
+    websocket = WebSocket({"type": "websocket", "path": "/"}, receive=receive, send=send)
+    await websocket.close()
+
+    with pytest.raises(WebSocketDisconnected, match='Cannot call "send" once a close message has been sent.'):
+        await websocket.send({"type": "websocket.close"})
+
+    assert issubclass(WebSocketDisconnected, RuntimeError)
+    assert WebSocketDisconnected is not RuntimeError
+
+
